A '''magnograsp transmitter''' was a type of [[Rifle/Legends|rifle]] that fired a [[Homing beacon/Legends|tracking device]]. Freedom fighters on [[Edan II/Legends|Edan II]], working in concert with [[Dantaree]] and members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]], used a magnograsp transmitter, attaching a tracking device to an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] vehicle to follow it back to the [[Imperial Collection Facility]].
